test_selection: All eligible unique heldout-file prompts after exact/token/5-token-window contamination removal against known prior and candidate training prompts and prior synthetic diagnostic sentences. Deterministic SHA256 order, maximum 2000 prompts per language. No outcomes read until candidate/configuration frozen.
development: Existing Sentence Collector text only: sha256(normalized prompt) mod 5 == 0 for development, remaining 80% for model search. Final assets use all training prompts, never heldout files.
seed_policy: No new hand-authored seeds based on holdout; prior seeds remain unchanged for the prior baseline only. Corpus-only candidate exploration excludes FrequencyWords/prior seeds from generation.
scope_limitations: Common Voice contributor-text evaluation is not universal messaging accuracy.
Legacy raw corpora unavailable, so historical sentence contamination cannot be ruled out.
Known near-overlap removal may favor unusual residual prompts; denominators and exclusions must be reported.
seal: A model-file/configuration hash must be recorded before test outputs are produced. No tuning after unseal in this review.
